description: The bar chart, titled “The Unseen Targets of Hate — A Systematic Review of Hateful Communication Datasets,” illustrates the annual growth in the number of datasets published between 2012 and 2022, categorized by whether they are “Untargeted” (blue) or “Targeted” (orange) — that is, whether they focus on specific social groups or not. The horizontal x-axis represents the year, ranging from 2012 to 2022, while the vertical y-axis indicates the “Number of datasets,” scaled from 0 to 160 in increments of 20. Each year is represented by a stacked bar, with the blue “Untargeted” portion at the bottom and the orange “Targeted” portion on top. The chart shows a clear upward trend over time: in 2012, only a few datasets existed (mostly untargeted), but by 2020, the total number of datasets surged to over 160, with targeted datasets becoming the dominant category. In 2020, for example, approximately 130 datasets were targeted and 30 were untargeted. The growth continues through 2021 and 2022, though the 2022 bar is partially shaded in light orange, possibly indicating preliminary or incomplete data. The chart visually emphasizes the increasing focus on targeted hate speech research in recent years.
